steps.en: Bootstrap the first host into a cluster with cephadm
steps.zh: 用 cephadm 把第一台机器引导成集群

steps.en: Creates the MON and MGR daemons and writes the cluster config and admin keyring
steps.zh: 建起 MON 与 MGR 守护进程，写出集群配置与 admin keyring

steps.en: Hand every free disk to the cluster as an OSD
steps.zh: 把每块空闲磁盘交给集群当 OSD
部署 S3 网关守护进程

steps.en: RGW answers the S3 API while CRUSH spreads objects across the OSDs
steps.zh: RGW 应答 S3 请求，CRUSH 把对象铺到各 OSD 上

steps.en: Create an S3 user and point clients at the RGW endpoint
steps.zh: 建一个 S3 用户，让客户端指向 RGW 端点

value.en: Object, block and file storage from one foundation-governed cluster — you stop running three separate storage systems, and start operating a storage cluster
value.zh: 一个基金会治理的集群同时提供对象、块与文件存储：不用再维护三套存储，代价是要真正运维一个存储集群

sources: https://docs.ceph.com/en/latest/cephadm/install/ (cephadm bootstrap --mon-ip <mon-ip>; creates MON and MGR, /etc/ceph/ceph.conf and client.admin keyring)
https://docs.ceph.com/en/latest/cephadm/services/rgw/ (ceph orch apply rgw <name>; RGW daemons serve the S3 API)
https://docs.ceph.com/en/latest/radosgw/admin/ (radosgw-admin user create --uid={username} --display-name="{display-name}" creates the S3 access key and secret key)
https://github.com/ceph/ceph#readme (Ceph is a distributed object, block, and file storage platform)
